text:
Marta (CS): FYI MapleComm pinged about onboarding a call-summarizer, they called out PII redaction and HSM for renewal. Copy from Olivia below.

Olivia (MapleComm PM): Hey team — we're scoped to onboard a real-time call summarizer for customer support calls. ~150k calls/month, avg 4m length. Need: 1) near-real-time (sub-2s after call end) short summary + action items; 2) automatic redaction of PII (phone, CC, SSNs); 3) retention: transcripts can't persist outside VPC; 4) must support HSM-managed keys or on-prem for compliance. Renewal due in 60 days, decision tied to feasibility & cost. Can you advise timeline/cost/requirements?

Devon (SE): thanks Olivia. couple quick q's: do you have sample transcripts (redacted)? what's your 95p latency target per call? is streaming during call required or just post-call? Also do you have a preferred model size? we can likely meet sub-2s post-call with dedicated 2xA100 and prefix cache.

Olivia (MapleComm PM): Post-call only is fine. We'll send sample transcripts tomorrow. No preference on model size but must be cost-sensitive — budget TBD. On HSM: legal insists on KMS/HSM; on-prem preferred but VPC with customer-managed keys ok.

Ravi (Eng): tagging @eng-ml — modelwise, a quantized 13B with optimized kv-cache should work for summaries. For 150k calls that's steady throughput; we'll need reserved capacity to meet SLOs. Cost estimate ballpark: dedicated pool + SLO ~ monthly. I'll sketch numbers after we see transcripts.

Devon (SE): initial checklist for me: 1) transcripts + transcripts per hour; 2) redaction rules & list; 3) retention window; 4) security contact. Also sending sample config snippet we use to validate streaming vs post-call:

```
# example: post-call ingestion
route: /calls/summarize
model: gpt-redwood-13b-q4
mode: post_call
kms: customer
retention_policy: no_persist
```

Marta (CS): Marking this as renewal-risk (60d). Can someone own an enablement call next week? Olivia — what days work?

Olivia (MapleComm PM): Tue/Thu mornings PT works. we'll attach SOC2/HIPAA details in the transcript pack.

Devon (SE): I'll take enablement + technical scoping. @security-team can you confirm HSM options and any extra compliance steps?

onboard-bot: checklist created: onboarding/1769007777, assigned_to: Devon, status: waiting_for_samples

Marta (CS): perfect. Devon — plz drop an initial risk note in Gainsight + add to renewal pipeline. I'll follow up with the account exec.

Ravi (Eng): after samples I can run a small perf bench on a 13B q4; expect results in 3 days.

Olivia (MapleComm PM): thanks all, sending samples today. appreciate the quick triage :heart:

Devon (SE): thanks! will confirm meeting invite once samples land. :thumbsup:
